items.author: Brenda M., extract vs. live query for Claude dashboards on Fabric, Nov 10
items.summary: Recap of a community session (demo by Ruben Van de Voorde): an extract shows everyone the author's data and skips row-level security, while a live query over a remote connection can honor RLS. Shows a Claude-built "Landed margin" dashboard. 2 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: David Piñeros, when dashboards stop being the bottleneck, Nov 10
items.summary: An AI agent set up by him built a publication-ready, on-brand Tableau dashboard from one prompt; he asks how analytics teams should reorganize around requirements, data prep, quality and trust in metrics. 2 reactions.

items.author: Lisa Hitch, Tableau Data Apps and Studio at Learning Fest, Nov 10
items.summary: Live notes on Tableau Data Apps, Tableau Knowledge and Tableau Studio; her takeaway from Joe Constantino's demo is that an AI-built app is only as good as the human who understands the problem. 7 reactions.
